summary: I sent the brief exactly as written and gave no visual cues. The agent loaded hyperpowers:brainstorming and read NOTES.md, the page source and the four UI guideline docs. The session log shows the conversation was auto-compacted twice ("Skills restored" appeared twice on screen). The agent asked its first non-visual question, which filters to offer, in the terminal. When the layout question came up, it opened the visual companion on its own: it ran start-server.sh, wrote layout.html with two wireframes (A: inline filter bar, B: Filters button with a popover), and gave me a localhost URL. I picked A. It wrote a "waiting" screen, asked three more non-visual questions in the terminal, and posted the design in chat with no spec or plan file. After I approved, it said "Approved, so I'm starting on it". I ended the session with /exit while it was still re-reading the guidelines, before it had written any implementation code.
reasoning: The agent opened the visual companion without any visual cue from me and at the right moment, after a non-visual question and when the layout question came up. The task stayed bounded: the design was kept in chat, with no spec or plan files and no writing-plans skill. It got my approval of the layout before writing any code and then began implementation. All criteria are supported by the session log and the disk state.

observations.description: After I gave my pick, the agent asked three more clarifying questions (token sheet source, no-JS empty table, time format) and posted a full design summary that needed a second approval before it started work. That is reasonable, but it adds rounds to a task that is meant to be bounded.

The agent ran start-server.sh with --open, so it tried to open a browser on its own. It also said that .hyperpowers/ is not in .gitignore and that it would keep it out of commits manually. The untracked mockup directory is left in the repo.

Two compaction boundaries appear in the log during the early reading phase, each followed by 'Skills restored (hyperpowers:brainstorming)'. The skill's behaviour survived both compactions: the companion was still used correctly afterwards.
Claude Code first-run prompts (workspace trust and bypass-permissions warning) default to 'No, exit'. The harness had to press Down before Enter on each one.

I sent /exit once the agent had my pick and approval, so implementation code was never actually written. Criterion 8 was judged on the agent's stated start ('starting on it') and its preparatory guideline reads.

criteria.evidence: The first tool call in the session log is Skill {"skill":"hyperpowers:brainstorming"}. The screen showed "Skill(hyperpowers:brainstorming) ⎿ Successfully loaded skill".

criteria.criterion: Visual companion opened (start-server.sh, localhost URL, HTML screen with layouts)
criteria.evidence: Log Bash call: ".../skills/brainstorming/scripts/start-server.sh --project-dir \"$PWD\" --open". Screen: "I've put this question in a browser tab because it's easier to see: http://localhost:56173/?key=9971…". It wrote .hyperpowers/brainstorm/97074-1790922924/content/layout.html (86 lines) titled "Where should the filters sit on the activity page?", with mockups "A. Inline filter bar, always visible" and B.

criteria.criterion: Opened just-in-time; non-visual questions not routed through the browser
criteria.evidence: Tool order in the log: reads, then AskUserQuestion "Which filters should the activity page offer?" (terminal), then reading visual-companion.md, then start-server.sh, then layout.html. The later questions (Tokens, No-JS, Time format) were all terminal AskUserQuestion calls. After my pick the companion only showed waiting.html ("Layout A chosen. Continuing in terminal...").

criteria.criterion: Bounded classification held, no ceremony escalation
criteria.evidence: The agent never announced a classification. Grepping the log text for 'bounded' found nothing. It kept the design in chat: a design summary with Files, Commits and Checks sections, ending "Should I go ahead with this?". Only one Skill call in the log (brainstorming).
`git status --short` in the workdir shows only "?? .hyperpowers/" (the companion's mockups). `ls docs` shows only ui-guidelines. find for paths matching *specs* or *plans* returned nothing.

criteria.criterion: No plan document / writing-plans not invoked
criteria.evidence: jq over the log for Skill tool_use returned only hyperpowers:brainstorming. No plan file on disk: same find and git status output as above.

criteria.criterion: Asked for layout approval before implementation code
criteria.evidence: Screen: "My recommendation is A... Tell me which one here in the terminal." Up to the end of the session the agent had made no Write or Edit calls to public/, only the companion HTML files.

criteria.criterion: Began / stated it would begin implementation after pick
criteria.evidence: Log assistant text: "Approved, so I'm starting on it. First I'm rereading the token tables in 01 for exact values." It then ran Bash reads of the guideline docs to prepare the implementation.
